name: Jiří Lehečka
signature: tall, athletic Czech with short dark hair and a quiet, serious face between points; big serve and flat first-strike forehand
exaggerate: upright, composed posture between points (barely any visible emotion)
big shoulder turn on the serve, then a step in to strike first
short, tidy hair; plain look with no accessories
source: personality: public media, one link per claim in `sources` (Nov 5 2026); signature/build: general public knowledge, still to check against images (height to confirm); outfits wait on uploads (#18) Body numbers added Nov 11 2026 from the 2026 ATP media guide where the player is listed, otherwise the source named in body.

grass.notes: all-white dress code; trim colours to research

hard.notes: Neutral default kit (navy shirt, white shorts). A citable US Open colour was not found for this run.

clay.notes: Neutral default kit. A citable clay colour was not found for this run.

personality.temperament: calm and focused; works on staying calm the whole match so he can concentrate on the big points
personality.style: aggressive first-strike baseliner built on the serve: goes after the points instead of waiting
mannerisms: little visible emotion between points (to confirm with clips)
celebrations: restrained: a clenched fist and a nod rather than a big show (to confirm)
personality.notes: public media; golf fan off court; lighter side shows in the locker room after hard matches

sources.claim: focused on the serve and on staying calm through the whole match, to concentrate on the important points (Doha 2023)
'I knew I could beat the top guys'; aggressive, goes after the points
laughs in the locker room after a hard-fought match (ATP, 2026)

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.
